goal: Add the smallest write-capable TUI application seam for category creation without changing frozen CatalogService, storage, schema, or CP-07T navigation
tests_explicitly_not_run: browser regression because web code is untouched
repository/domain regression because frozen core is untouched
visual evidence because runtime layout is untouched
risks: the adapter is intentionally not yet connected to an input widget or runtime binding
user-facing error wording and refresh behavior remain for the next separately gated UI step
non_changes: no trash/restore, undo, autosave or crash-recovery
no theme, dependency or CI changes
expected_side_effects: a later gated UI step can inject CategoryWriteAdapter and collect a category name without importing storage or SQL into the TUI
